title: FurnaceUpgrades
description: Upgrade furnaces with materials to boost smelting speed. Features holograms, particle effects, and 12 languages.
body:
# FurnaceUpgrades

  Tired of slow smelting? Transform your ordinary furnaces into powerful, self-improving machines!

  ## Features

  - Speed Up Smelting - Upgrade furnaces by clicking with materials. Each tier increases speed up to 1.8x at max level!
  - Hologram Display - Every upgraded furnace shows a floating hologram with tier, speed, and requirements.
  - Particle Effects - Stunning fireworks and particles on every upgrade.
  - 12 Languages - English, Czech, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish, Russian, Japanese, Korean,
  Chinese.
  - Persistent Data - Break and pick up upgraded furnaces with SHIFT + PICKAXE - tiers are preserved!
  - Works Everywhere - Perfect for Skyblock, survival, or any server type.

  ## How to Use

  - Left-click furnace with materials to upgrade
  - SHIFT + Left-click to break upgraded furnace (pickaxe required)
  - Tier and speed are saved in the item

  ## Commands

-    /fu reload - Reload configuration

  ## Permissions

```
  - furnaceupgrades.upgrade (all players) - Upgrade furnaces
  - furnaceupgrades.reload (op only) - Reload config
  - furnaceupgrades.see (all players) - View holograms
```


  ## Upgrade Tiers

  - Tier 1: 5x Iron Ingot -> 1.1x speed
  - Tier 2: 5x Gold Ingot -> 1.2x speed
  - Tier 3: 5x Diamond -> 1.4x speed
  - Tier 4: 5x Emerald -> 1.6x speed
  - Tier 5: 5x Obsidian -> 1.8x speed

  ## Requirements

  - Paper or Spigot server
  - Minecraft 1.20.4+
  - Java 21+

  All settings fully customizable in config.yml.
